description: ECC Native Hook Manifest — declarative spec for hook architecture. Settings.json contains the authoritative, active hook chain. This file documents the architecture; it is not consumed by Claude Code directly.

profiles.minimal: Security checks only. No observations, no monitoring.
profiles.standard: Security + governance + quality gate + session activity. Default.
profiles.strict: Full auditing: all hooks enabled, context monitor active, desktop notify on stop.

deprecated_spec_entries.note: These were declared in earlier versions but are not wired into settings.json. They exist on disk for reference but do not fire.
